package.description: The Open Source modelling toolkit for creating ArchiMate models and sketches.

en-US.description: The Open Source modelling toolkit for creating ArchiMate models and sketches.
en-US.longDescription:
Archi® is a free, open source, cross-platform tool and editor to create ArchiMate models.
The Archi® modelling tool is targeted toward all levels of Enterprise Architects and Modellers. It provides a low cost to entry solution to users who may be making their first steps in the ArchiMate modelling language, or who are looking for a free, cross-platform ArchiMate modelling tool for their company or institution and wish to engage with the language within a TOGAF® or other Enterprise Architecture framework.
ArchiMate® is an open and independent Enterprise Architecture modelling language that supports the description, analysis and visualization of architecture within and across business domains. ArchiMate is one of the open standards hosted by The Open Group and is fully aligned with TOGAF®.
en-US.name: Archi

zh-CN.description: 开源建模工具包，用于创建 ArchiMate 模型与草图。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Archi® 是一款免费、开源、跨平台的工具及编辑器，用于创建 ArchiMate 模型。
该建模工具面向各层级的架构师与建模人员，为初次接触 ArchiMate 建模语言的用户提供低门槛解决方案，同时也为寻求免费跨平台建模工具的企业或机构提供支持，助力用户在 TOGAF® 或其他企业架构框架中实践该语言。
ArchiMate® 作为一种开放且独立的企业架构建模语言，支持跨业务领域架构的描述、分析与可视化。该语言由 The Open Group 主持开发，是旗下开放标准之一，并与 TOGAF® 保持全面兼容。
